title: The Tunnel Fire That Closed the Alps for 3 Years
description:
How did one truck fire close a key Alpine tunnel for three years?

Sources:
- U.S. Department of Transportation: https://www.transportation.gov/
- International Transport Forum: https://www.itf-oecd.org/

Technical illustrations and dependency models are labelled. Estimates and industry claims are attributed; modeled consequences are not presented as observed fact.
